name: calculator/switch-mode
description: Open Calculator and switch it to Scientific mode using its navigation menu.
source_task: Open Calculator and switch it to Scientific mode by clicking through its navigation menu (do not use keyboard shortcuts). This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.

steps.note: Opens the navigation menu with the hamburger button. No keyboard shortcut is used.
Picks the mode from the navigation menu. The header then reads e.g. 'Scientific Calculator mode'.
The navigation menu closes by itself after a choice. The Calculator window stays open.
